HexKagune 1.0.29 for Forge 1.20.1 (clients need PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon). Install on client and server (protocol 45). Testing build.

- **Black Reaper (J, hold):** three black centipedes burst out of your back and arc over your shoulders at what you aim at (18 blocks). They bite in and drag it toward you while you hold the key. Within 2 blocks your blade goes through it (bleed, slow, stun), holds it up a moment and throws it off its feet. Let go and they retreat into your back; letting go before they latch only costs a short 3 s wait.
- **King's Defiance (C, hold):** your right arm covers your face and the rinkaku grow thick and close into a sphere around you. You can't be hurt while it's held (10 s max, it always closes fully even on a tap). Everything that hits it gets a spike grown straight out of the cocoon at it (bleed), which then sinks back in. You're rooted while inside.
- **Spire Wave (B, hold and release):** point your left hand and centipedes coil and grow around the arm, more and bigger the longer you hold (full at 3 s). Let go and they surge out along your aim, slow and heavy, up to 25 blocks (stopped by walls). Everything they reach is carried along, crushed together at the end and slammed down.
- **No attacks or other abilities while a held move is going.**
- The old Black Reaper dash, Spire slam and Defiance parry are gone, replaced by these.
